blockers.name: Repo is not a git worktree
blockers.why: The plan explicitly gates plugin packaging on a real git repo.

blockers.name: Account or admin gating for cloud and team surfaces
blockers.why: These are real Cursor features, but not guaranteed locally for this repo.

blockers.name: Tool-count pressure
blockers.why: Active MCP sprawl can reduce tool selection quality and waste context budget.

blockers.name: Plugin schema should be re-verified at packaging time
blockers.why: Plugin surfaces are still evolving and should not be hard-coded prematurely.

blockers.name: Sandbox policy is defined but not centrally enforced in repo files
blockers.why: Cursor sandbox controls live in product settings or dashboard surfaces, not only in tracked repo files.

blockers.name: Context7 pilot verdict is not final yet
affects: external MCP rollout beyond the first pilot
blockers.why: The repo has the pilot rubric, but the evaluation result is not yet closed.
